widget.title: Active Issues by Severity

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:all_baseline_issue_summary" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = a.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = a.product_id and p.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter a.status = "Active"
    and a.last_modified >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_modified <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
    and ${severity_filter_predicate}
| select {
    (case
        when a.severity_code = "Critical" then 5
        when a.severity_code = "High" then 4
        when a.severity_code = "Medium" then 3
        when a.severity_code = "Low" then 2
        when a.severity_code = "Info" then 1
        else 0
    end) as severity_order,
    a.severity_code as severity,
    distinct_count(a.issue_id) as active_issues
}
| group_by severity_order, a.severity_code
| order_by severity_order desc
| limit 10

widget.subtitle: Severity mix of unique active issues

widget.title: Top Vulnerable Projects

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:latest_baseline_scan" l
| join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.internal_id = l.scan_internal_id
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = l.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = l.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = l.product_id and p.account_identifier = l.account_identifier
| join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = l.target_id
| filter t.is_deleted = false
    and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${target_filter_predicate}
    and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
| select {
    h_l.org_identifier as organization,
    h_l.project_identifier as project,
    distinct_count(l.target_id) as targets,
    sum(l.critical) as critical,
    sum(l.high) as high,
    sum(l.medium) as medium,
    sum(l.low) as low,
    sum(l.critical * 16 + l.high * 7 + l.medium * 2) as risk_score
}
| group_by h_l.org_identifier, h_l.project_identifier
| order_by risk_score desc
| limit 10

widget.subtitle: Projects ranked by weighted risk score of their latest baseline scans
